checkout_drafts_lengths.name: checkout_drafts_lengths
checkout_drafts_lengths.value: length("checkout_drafts"."phone") <= 20 and length("checkout_drafts"."name") <= 100 and length("checkout_drafts"."address") <= 500 and length("checkout_drafts"."product_name") <= 300

discounts_title.name: discounts_title
discounts_title.value: char_length("discounts"."title") <= 100 and ("discounts"."code" is not null or "discounts"."title" <> '')

discounts_value.name: discounts_value
discounts_value.value: "discounts"."value" > 0 and ("discounts"."kind" = 'amount' or "discounts"."value" <= 100) and "discounts"."min_subtotal" >= 0 and "discounts"."min_qty" >= 0 and ("discounts"."max_uses" is null or "discounts"."max_uses" > 0) and "discounts"."uses" >= 0

discounts_bxgy.name: discounts_bxgy
discounts_bxgy.value:
case when "discounts"."type" = 'bxgy' then "discounts"."kind" = 'percent' and "discounts"."buy_qty" between 1 and 100 and "discounts"."get_qty" between 1 and 100 and ("discounts"."max_per_order" is null or "discounts"."max_per_order" between 1 and 100)
    else "discounts"."buy_qty" is null and "discounts"."get_qty" is null and "discounts"."max_per_order" is null end

shipping_rates_amounts.name: shipping_rates_amounts
shipping_rates_amounts.value: "shipping_rates"."price" between 0 and 100000 and "shipping_rates"."free_over" between 1 and 10000000 and "shipping_rates"."free_min_qty" between 2 and 1000

stores_details_length.name: stores_details_length
stores_details_length.value: char_length("stores"."address") <= 300 and char_length("stores"."legal_name") <= 100 and char_length("stores"."trade_licence") <= 50 and char_length("stores"."bin") <= 50 and char_length("stores"."invoice_note") <= 300
